businesses.business: Network testing, optical components and navigation systems

offering_description.value: VIAVI designs and manufactures test instruments and develops software for telecom operators, equipment makers, data center operators and enterprises to build and monitor networks. It also manufactures optical filters, anti-counterfeiting pigments and positioning and navigation systems for device makers, security printers and aerospace and defense customers.

primary_products.value: fiber, wireless and Ethernet test instruments; network monitoring and assurance software; precision optical filters; anti-counterfeiting pigments; inertial navigation systems

primary_services.value: instrument calibration and repair; technical training; network testing and deployment consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecom operators, network contractors, equipment manufacturers, data center operators, enterprises, security printers and aerospace suppliers; B2G: defense agencies and government network operators

end_markets.value: telecommunications; enterprise networking and data centers; banknote and document security; consumer and industrial optical sensing; aerospace and defense

revenue_model.value: product sales: network test instruments, optical filters, security pigments and navigation hardware; licensing or royalties: network test, monitoring and service assurance software licenses; subscription: recurring access to network monitoring and assurance software; service fees: calibration, repair, training and technical consulting
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: integrates optical and electronic components into test instruments and navigation systems for operators and equipment makers; software / platform: processes network telemetry and test data for operators and enterprise IT teams; component supplier: turns optical materials into filters and pigments for equipment makers and security printers; service provider: calibrates and repairs instruments and provides training to network operators and contractors
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: diversified: network testing and assurance, optical security and sensing components, and positioning and navigation systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams serving network operators, equipment manufacturers, security printers and government customers; distributors / dealers: specialist test and measurement distributors serving contractors and network teams; partners / resellers: systems integrators and technology resellers serving enterprise and government customers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. export controls on sensitive equipment and electronics rules such as EU RoHS and REACH

notes: The relative scale of the optical and navigation lines and the current mix of software licensing and subscriptions are uncertain.
